content: This resource tells about using Ampere?s Law for calculating magnetic fields from symmetric current distributions, to find an expression for the magnetic field of a cylindrical current-carrying shell of inner radius a and outer radius b using Ampere?s Law and to find an expression for the magnetic field of a slab of current using Ampere?s Law.
